name: Poppers
summary: Poppers is a other substance belonging to the Poppers chemical class.

pharmacology.text: When fumes from these substances are inhaled, they act as potent vasodilators, producing mild euphoria, warmth, and dizziness. Poppers act as muscle relaxants, causing the relaxation of involuntary smooth muscles such as the throat and anus.

body.says: When inhaled; Amyl nitrite: unknown; Isopropyl nitrite: 43%; Isobutyl nitrite: unknown
Suspected to be minutes to less than an hour
Amyl nitrite: pentanol (amyl alcohol); Isopropyl nitrite: isopropanol; Isobutyl nitrite: isobutanol

uses.text: Poppers are recreational drugs belonging to the alkyl nitrite family of chemical compounds. Amyl nitrite was originally prescribed in the late 1800s for the medical management of angina.

sideEffects.text: Reported adverse effects include fainting, retinal toxicity, and vision loss.

summaryZh: Rush Poppers，又可簡稱芳香劑、Rush或Poppers，是各種亞硝酸酯——特別是亞硝酸異丙酯、亞硝酸異丁酯以及較為罕見的亞硝酸正丁酯和亞硝酸異戊酯——的代稱。
summaryZhHans: Rush Poppers，又可简称芳香剂、Rush或Poppers，是各种亚硝酸酯——特别是亚硝酸异丙酯、亚硝酸异丁酯以及较为罕见的亚硝酸正丁酯和亚硝酸异戊酯——的代称。

fact.en: Amyl nitrite was first used in medicine in 1867 by the Scottish doctor Thomas Lauder Brunton to relieve angina. It was sold in small glass capsules that were crushed to release the vapour, making a popping sound that gave poppers their name.
fact.zh: 亞硝酸戊酯最早在 1867 年由蘇格蘭醫師 Thomas Lauder Brunton 用於緩解心絞痛。它當時裝在小玻璃安瓿中，捏碎時會發出「啵」的一聲，「poppers」這個名字就是由此而來。
fact.zhHans: 亚硝酸戊酯最早在 1867 年由苏格兰医师 Thomas Lauder Brunton 用于缓解心绞痛。它当时装在小玻璃安瓿中，捏碎时会发出「啵」的一声，「poppers」这个名字就是由此而来。
